latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Tutoring Service Video — an AI-powered video production solution designed for tutoring professionals.

- Enables creation of client acquisition videos, tutor introductions, subject-specific previews, student success stories, platform demos, and enrollment campaigns.
- Serves a wide range of users including independent tutors, tutoring centers, online platforms, test prep providers, special education specialists, and coaching programs.
- Targets the critical need for high-quality video marketing to boost visibility and client conversion in a competitive $8.5B tutoring industry.
- Helps tutoring providers showcase real academic outcomes and differentiate from franchise competitors with polished, evidence-driven video content.
